scope: Thirteen bounded source issues already represented by reviewed claims; classification and required evidence, not new source claims or deployed behavior.

records.issue: Knipper uses QC Hold for all inbound LPNs, later QA Hold or check-in-assigned status after putaway, and names Available/HOLD FOR DEST AUTH after inspection. The early visual audit and later selected reserve inspection can be distinct stages, but status equivalence and transition timing are not defined.
records.documentary_qualification: Keep each label and stage as written; do not equate QC Hold, QA Hold, Client Hold or HQ, or infer an automatic transition.
records.required_evidence: Site/version-specific status dictionary and approved receiving/QC workflow identifying stage, actor, trigger and pass/fail mapping; observed configuration or controlled acceptance trace for actual behavior.

records.issue: Knipper says successful component work is immediately available, yet body/replies require work-order release and describe header-level release with one troubled line not holding others. Component allocation-rule failure and conditional release allocation add uncertainty.
records.documentary_qualification: Describe creation, allocation, retry and release separately. Treat the line-independence reply as a design statement, not permission to execute unreleased work.
records.required_evidence: Approved release/work eligibility specification for this site/version, component-failure state transitions and rule configuration; controlled tests for header release with one failed line and successful component work.

records.issue: One Knipper paragraph requires shipments at Ship Confirm Pending before Confirm Load; the next describes load leading/trailing statuses at Ship Confirm Pending.
records.documentary_qualification: Retain shipment-level and load-level wording separately; do not select a code-level gate.
records.required_evidence: Status model and actual Confirm Load precondition for the named release/configuration, including load versus shipment leading/trailing status definitions.

records.issue: Grupo page85 uses all shipments Ship Confirm Pending; page48 calls Load Confirm Pending (800) the ready-to-confirm load state.
records.documentary_qualification: The terms may refer to different entities or stages, but the source does not prove their relationship; no executable predicate follows.
records.required_evidence: Grupo release status-transition specification or controlled observation binding each status to load and shipment entities and the Confirm Load precondition.

records.issue: Knipper labels both Custom Receipt from Shipment and multiple Work Insight document printing EX40; printing is conditional on approval.
records.documentary_qualification: Index by function plus page context, never EX40 alone. The collision does not prove either behavior was delivered.
records.required_evidence: Approved extension inventory and separate functional design/change IDs, implementation artifacts and deployment evidence for each behavior.

records.issue: Named EX01, EX19, EX24/EX39 and Covetrus pending generic-data-bind/notification items are documented at high level or proposed. Their detailed protocols, validation, triggers and delivery are absent.
records.documentary_qualification: Keep named site-specific extension behavior and future proposals out of generic/base SCALE instructions; do not turn a resolved comment into implementation proof.
records.required_evidence: The referenced extension designs, approved change records, executable contract/configuration and deployed acceptance evidence for each named site/release.

records.issue: HADDAD prose describes a warehouse-null criterion; its cited screenshot shows an OR over incoming putdown location and work type.
records.documentary_qualification: Show both source accounts; neither is safe as an active selection rule.
records.required_evidence: Approved QC assignment export/configuration for the named HADDAD release and explanation of screenshot/prose revision history.

records.issue: HADDAD prose says Manual QC is chosen; its assignment screenshot has Manual unchecked and Start Work/Wave checked.
records.documentary_qualification: A method present in the catalog is distinct from its selection on an assignment.
records.required_evidence: Approved assignment configuration and revision/version context plus a controlled check of the active trigger.

records.issue: Knipper body says a short pick creates count work; an adjacent comment says Knipper does not short pick, then marks the comment resolved without supplying a new trigger.
records.documentary_qualification: State the described trigger and the claimed operating practice separately. The comment does not erase the design trigger.
records.required_evidence: Approved short-pick policy, configured trigger and controlled event evidence if an operational claim is needed.

records.issue: Grupo states a current 9999 tolerance to review and a planned zero tolerance. Current and intended design values differ by time; that alone is not a simultaneous runtime contradiction.
records.documentary_qualification: Preserve current-versus-planned language and avoid selecting either for the assessed deployment.
records.required_evidence: Dated approved configuration decision and live site setting if a current tolerance must be stated.

records.issue: The Work/Picking compilation describes pick-to-tote cart grouping and also says only Pick into shipping container is currently supported.
records.documentary_qualification: Do not infer a release chronology or installed tote-cart capability from this undated compilation.
records.required_evidence: Release-specific vendor capability matrix and site method configuration or controlled application acceptance.

records.issue: Covetrus documents outbound QC and TLC Force QC pass; Grupo explicitly says outbound QC is not currently used. These are different named implementation examples.
records.documentary_qualification: Qualify each by site and version. Generic QC screens/actions do not establish Grupo adoption or Covetrus behavior in the assessed environment.
records.required_evidence: No conflict resolution needed; obtain the assessed site/version configuration and acceptance evidence only before making a current-deployment claim.

records.issue: Knipper describes current manual SCALE entry of Cubiscan measurements and separately discusses a possible HLE integration requiring detailed design.
records.documentary_qualification: The proposal is not an implemented path; documentary qualification resolves this apparent difference.
records.required_evidence: Approved integration design and deployed interface/acceptance evidence only if claiming automated capture.
